lines.text: Twitter needed ten thousand IDs a second.
No repeats, without servers coordinating. How?
In 2010 they built Snowflake: one number, three parts.
First, the time, to the millisecond.
Then a counter, for IDs in the same millisecond.
Our test: three machines, the same millisecond, nine IDs, zero repeats.
In JavaScript, keep IDs as strings, or different IDs can become one number.
